question: With as much ability as Otto has, I think it should have been possible to start working his way up from the bottom at a company somewhere; was there a reason that he was drawn to being a travelling merchant?
answer: Otto is being targeted by an assassin hired by the daughter of an influential person in his hometown, and when he left home, he made a show of saying “I won’t accept any help! I’ll show you I can do it myself!” or something, so he probably didn’t want to start working under someone, he wanted to make his own way as a travelling merchant. Despite that, he’s the Minister of the Interior. Where did he go wrong.
